TrajectoryDataset (Legacy API Reference)
=========================================

The TrajectoryDataset class is now located in the ``dpnn.data`` module.

.. automodule:: dpnn.data.dataset
   :members:
   :undoc-members:
   :show-inheritance:

For new code, import from:

.. code-block:: python

    from dpnn.data import TrajectoryDataset
    from dpnn.data.dataset import TrajectoryDataset  # Alternative
